name: 229. MCP server from OpenAPI spec (mcp-openapi-spec)
description: Management-plane regression for connection_type "openapi": POST /api/mcp/openapi/preview parses Swagger 2.0 and OpenAPI 3.0/3.1/3.2 documents into the same tool set, POST /api/mcp/client registers a client whose MCP server is synthesized from the document (tools carry the <client>-<tool> prefix, the stored document is not echoed by GET /api/mcp/clients), and the create path refuses auth types the synthesized server cannot honor and tool names the document does not define. The upstream is the public Swagger Petstore because the harness profile has no admin auth configured, which confines registrations to public targets; no tool is called. The openai keyword in case names is only a harness filter label.
